as_told.title: Asberg's 1996 UFO sighting after waking unusually early

plain: In 1996 a round craft hung over a military installation outside Stockholm, Sweden, and from one angle it "looks like a hot dog," according to Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter who tells Michels he saw it himself. He adds that he woke up unusually early that day, for a reason he says he still doesn't understand, and he mentions UFO Sweden, a Swedish UFO organization. If he is right, an unknown craft flew openly over a military site.
